name: TipPoolDistributionCalculator
tagline: Fair, balanced and auditable tip pools – split by hours and points, approve, pay and export the payout sheet in one Power Apps component.
description: A complete tip pool app for restaurants, bars and hotels: every shift pool is split by hours × role points, hours, points or equally, with a back-of-house tip-out, excluded manager roles, optional card-fee deduction and service charge, and cent-exact rounding so the pool always balances. The app flags missing or impossible hours and out-of-date payouts, takes each pool through Draft → Submitted → Approved → Paid with disputes and role rules, keeps a history of every change and produces the period payout sheet (payroll vs cash) for export. Works in demo mode the moment it is dropped and connects to any data source in a few clicks.
features: Hours × points, hours, points or equal split with a what-if switch
Excluded roles (managers / owners) never receive a share
Card-fee % on card tips and optional service charge
Largest-remainder rounding – balances to the cent, cash steps with carry-forward
Minimum / maximum hours rules and duplicate checks
Out-of-date payout detection and one-click Recalculate & apply
Draft → Submitted → Approved → Paid workflow with disputes, resolve and re-open
Roles: team member, shift supervisor, manager / payroll
Period payout sheet (payroll vs cash, paid, unpaid, disputed) with CSV export
History, undo, search, filters, sorting and grouping
Power Fx outputs and events (PayoutSheetCsv, SummaryJson, NewRecordJson)
controlType: standard (2 controls: data-set + Power Pages field control)
